candidates.title: Faster Than Flash: Exploiting Attention Sparsity for Efficient Long-Context Decoding
candidates.reason: Fused selector/compute sparse-attention kernel avoids external metadata and reports up to 11.6x kernel speedup and 2.37x end-to-end throughput for long-context decoding.

candidates.title: Hybrid JIT-CUDA Graph Optimization for Low-Latency Large Language Model Inference
candidates.reason: Hybrid JIT/CUDA Graph runtime partitions static/dynamic decode execution and reports up to 66% TTFT reduction; useful runtime-design omission.

candidates.title: PAT: Accelerating LLM Decoding via Prefix-Aware Attention with Resource Efficient Multi-Tile Kernel
candidates.reason: Prefix-aware decode-attention kernel reduces repeated shared-prefix KV loads and integrates as a vLLM plugin; reports large attention/TPOT reductions.
